text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A piercing gaze felt at the racetrack. Was 
the one watching Nakayama Festa a 
reporter, or an Umamusume debuting on the 
very same day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the naked hostility, Nakayama Festa 
shivers with excitement. A fearless smile 
graces her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Nakayama Festa's 
elementary school teacher watches on with 
deep emotion, proud to see their former 
pupil standing on this grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—At long last, Nakayama Festa's debut race 
is about to begin.
